exempt_paths.$comment: Whole paths the check does not read, each for a reason that does not expire with a rename.
exempt_paths.drizzle/meta/: migration history: the journal's schema snapshots are immutable records of what each migration produced; rewriting one would make drift lie
exempt_paths.scripts/fixtures/: pinned before-images: the pre-rename package surface, the default profile's model-facing surface and an old schema, kept verbatim so tests can prove the migrations and translations against them
exempt_paths.scripts/fde/lib/: two one-line re-exports kept at the operator tooling's old lib paths (customer.mjs, which the software factory's workspace seeding imports, and the old helpers module), so an import written against the old path still resolves; the code is in scripts/operator/lib/
exempt_paths.scripts/lib/neutral-names.mjs: the check, which has to describe what it matches
exempt_paths.scripts/test-neutral-names.mjs: the check's test, which constructs an offender of every kind
exempt_paths.package-lock.json: the root package's name (`fde-agent`, an infrastructure name) as npm records it

contracts.$comment: Exact names that something outside this repository already holds. Each moves by an additive migration with the old name kept working; the plan says which PR. A name listed here that no longer occurs anywhere fails the check.

base_word.$comment: Per file, the exact count of the bare word today, grouped by why it may stay. More fails; fewer fails with the number to lower it to.

default.why: The default deployment profile's own words. `profiles/00-default.json` names the member "FDE" and the owner "FDE owner"; the base text a model or a person reads (tool descriptions, prompts, the library workflows under scripts/operator/workflows/, the generated copies of all three, the base product's own setup skill and package README) is written in those words and translated per profile at the tool and UI boundary (agent/lib/agent-vocabulary.ts, lib/ui-words.ts), which check:agent-vocabulary and check:ui-vocabulary prove for a relabelled deployment. Rewording these changes what the default deployment says, so it is not done under a no-behaviour-change rename.

machinery.why: The vocabulary machinery and its gates: the word as data to translate, label or refuse (base-word lists, translation rules, their tests and the negative assertions that prove a relabelled deployment never shows it), and the history of the earlier renames it records.

stored.why: Stored enum values (a ticket's `ownerTeam: "FDE"`, a value-evidence status `"FDE Verified"`) and the sample and fixture records that carry them. Changing a stored value is a data migration; these are left as data and shown through the profile.

operator.why: The MCP server key a new engineer is told to add in setup/TEAM-SETUP.md. The rest of the operator tooling moved in PR 2 (scripts/operator/, `npm run operator:*`, every old script name kept as an alias); this goes with the setup bins in PR 3.
